sources.title: From Noisy Telemetry to Actionable Warnings: GPU Failure Prediction in Industrial Clusters
sources.snippet: GPU clusters are critical infrastructure for AI services, but accurate and actionable GPU failure prediction remains a problem in production settings. We study ticket-linked telemetry from a ByteDance GPU cluster and identify three obstacles: workload-confounded telemetry, heterogeneous fault precursors, and the gap between window-level predictions and actionable alerts.
